title: Skincare for Air Pollution in India: A Simple Smog-Season Routine
ex: What smog and dust do to your skin, a simple day and night routine for high-AQI months, what each skin type needs, and the mistakes that make it worse.
rt: Skincare for Air Pollution in India: Smog Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skincare for air pollution in India: a simple day and night routine for smoggy months, what each skin type needs, and mistakes that make dull, dry skin worse.
quick: Skincare for pollution is mostly habit, not a special product. Wear sunscreen and a light moisturiser in the morning, then at night remove sunscreen and grime gently, wash with a mild face wash and apply a night cream on slightly damp skin.
facts: Smog season in North India runs roughly late October to February
Grey, hazy skies do not block UV: sunscreen still matters
Skip actives on days skin stings
